routing.algorithm: existing slope-cost A* from tools/route_path.py with an added per-edge 40-degree grade guard
routing.water_policy: authored sea, lake and river cells cost 25 x horizontal traversal; required bridge crossings are mandatory waypoints

route_01_pallet_to_brock.basis: the built Route 1 maze forest's main path (tools/maze_forest.py NETWORK: entry, braid1_west, mid_1, braid2_west past the world-tree sapling, mid_2, braid3_northwest, exit), pinned 2026-09-16 because the forest was built on the pre-sculpt route line. Entrance and exit alone left the route up to 57 blocks off the maze's corridors; every main-path node keeps 96.6% of the forest stretch within 8 blocks of a corridor (max 10.2).

route_04_surge_to_erika.basis: west of the Merian cirque. Without it, leg 4 from Surge's town passes too close to the Displaced City (towns rule: a major town at least 250 off the critical path) and too far from the Merian hut (a rest stop, 100-450). With it, on the final routes: 287 and 120; leg 4 is 3,453 blocks, climb 54, steepest step 24.15 degrees.

route_07_sabrina_to_blaine.basis: required bridge crossing, as forced by the 2026-09-15 derivation

victory_road.basis: the measured Rift entry into the south-west arm, the fork, and the apex (this route's barriers' source coordinates); the trunk runs fork to apex

review_findings: Legs 1-8 are computed from terrain and are not fit to towns.json distances.
Victory Road is computed between measured Rift arm, fork, trunk and apex waypoints.
Every polyline point includes sampled elevation; route elevation records climb, grade and slope-limit exceedances.
Spawn rectangles exactly cover the 8-block corridor raster, keeping overspill below the 15% requirement.
Every dense path sample lies inside a sub-region polygon (subregion_holes count 0), so no hole blocks spawn compilation.
